description: Collect a LinkedIn profile's recent public activity: posts and reposts, comments, and reactions. No cookie or login is needed.

activityTypes.description: Which public activity tabs to collect. Posts includes reposts; comments includes replies. The legacy value shares is accepted and returned as posts/reposts.
activityTypes.title: Activity Types

includePostDetails.description: Open each target post for full text, exact dates, engagement totals, media, and comment timestamps. Turn off for a faster card-only run.
includePostDetails.title: Include Post Details

maxActivitiesPerProfile.description: Maximum records per profile across the selected activity types. Public profiles show one pageful per tab.
maxActivitiesPerProfile.title: Max Activities Per Profile

maxDate.description: Keep posts and comments whose exact activity date is on or before this date. Reactions have no public event date and are kept.
maxDate.title: Maximum Date

maxItems.description: Maximum activity records for the whole run. Error rows do not count toward this limit.
maxItems.title: Max Items

minDate.description: Keep posts and comments whose exact activity date is on or after this date. Reactions have no public event date and are kept.
minDate.title: Minimum Date

profileUrls.description: Public LinkedIn profile URLs or usernames. Accepts https://www.linkedin.com/in/name, country subdomains, and bare usernames.
profileUrls.title: Profile URLs

title: LinkedIn Profile Engagement Timeline Scraper Input
